module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.PreparedParameterProjectionTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPreparedSlotAppend
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open NormalForm PreparedProjection

abbrev Packet := List LowerOperand × Formula

/-- Zero is the one raw coordinate being varied, not a table slot.
Only positive names in the appended packet acquire an offset. -/
def shiftName (d : Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => d + (n + 1)

def view (d : Nat) (ν : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat := fun n => ν (shiftName d n)

def shiftSummand (d : Nat) : Summand → Summand
  | .variable i => .variable (shiftName d i)
  | .phi i e => .phi (shiftName d i) e
  | .hyperPhi i e h => .hyperPhi (shiftName d i) e h

def shiftRow (d : Nat) (r : Row) : Row :=
  (r.1,r.2.map fun t => (t.1,shiftSummand d t.2))

def shiftAtom (d : Nat) : Atom → Atom
  | .nonnegative r => .nonnegative (shiftRow d r)
  | .divisible m r => .divisible m (shiftRow d r)

def shift (d : Nat) : Formula → Formula
  | .truth => .truth
  | .falsity => .falsity
  | .atom a => .atom (shiftAtom d a)
  | .negative p => .negative (shift d p)
  | .conjunction p q => .conjunction (shift d p) (shift d q)
  | .disjunction p q => .disjunction (shift d p) (shift d q)

def append (left right : Packet) : Packet :=
  (left.1 ++ right.1,.conjunction left.2 (shift left.1.length right.2))

/-- Merge only the lower table addresses. The assembled reserved
coordinate is always the left assignment's zeroth value. -/
def merge (d : Nat) (ν₁ ν₂ : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  if n ≤ d then ν₁ n else ν₂ (n-d)

def ExactSlotShift : Prop :=
  (∀ (d : Nat) (ν : Nat → Nat), view d ν 0 = ν 0) ∧
  ∀ (d : Nat) (p : Formula),
    (shift d p).variables = p.variables.map (shiftName d) ∧
    (PlainPreparedFormula p →
      PlainPreparedFormula (shift d p) ∧ ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat),
        ((shift d p).eval ν ↔ p.eval (view d ν)))

def ExactAppendedReads : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (left right : List LowerOperand),
    (∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < left.length),
      ∃ hab : j < (left ++ right).length,
        (left ++ right)[j] = left[j] ∧
        lowerOperandRead f ρ ((left ++ right)[j]) = lowerOperandRead f ρ left[j]) ∧
    (∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < right.length),
      ∃ hab : left.length+j < (left ++ right).length,
        (left ++ right)[left.length+j] = right[j] ∧
        lowerOperandRead f ρ ((left ++ right)[left.length+j]) = lowerOperandRead f ρ right[j]) ∧
    (∀ (ν : Nat → Nat),
      (PreparedTableTied f top ρ (left ++ right) ν ↔
        PreparedTableTied f top ρ left ν ∧ PreparedTableTied f top ρ right (view left.length ν))) ∧
    ∀ (ν₁ ν₂ : Nat → Nat),
      PreparedTableTied f top ρ left ν₁ → PreparedTableTied f top ρ right ν₂ →
      PreparedTableTied f top ρ (left ++ right) (merge left.length ν₁ ν₂)

def ExactPreparedAppend : Prop :=
  ∀ (left right : Packet), PreparedInput left.1 left.2 → PreparedInput right.1 right.2 →
    let both := append left right
    PreparedInput both.1 both.2 ∧
    (∀ (ν : Nat → Nat), both.2.eval ν ↔ left.2.eval ν ∧ right.2.eval (view left.1.length ν)) ∧
    ∀ (ν₁ ν₂ : Nat → Nat), ν₁ 0 = ν₂ 0 →
      (both.2.eval (merge left.1.length ν₁ ν₂) ↔ left.2.eval ν₁ ∧ right.2.eval ν₂)

def FullActualPreparedSlotAppend : Prop :=
  ExactSlotShift ∧ ExactAppendedReads ∧ ExactPreparedAppend

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPreparedSlotAppend

6	namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh
7	open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison PreparedProjection
8	open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
9	open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
10	open SignedRowGuardedTest (Test sourceTestAt)
11	open StableSortedHighField (Packet basePacket orderGuard)
12	open OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormula (choosePolarity)
13	
14	inductive OrderTest where
15	  | equalZero | nonnegative | positive
16	
17	def OrderTest.test : OrderTest → Test
18	  | .equalZero => .equalZero
19	  | .nonnegative => .nonnegative
20	  | .positive => .positive
21	
22	/-- The exact requested comparison outcome and whether to assert it.
23	Zero weight is not admitted by the signed-pair theorem. -/
24	def request (k : OrderTest) (c : Int) : Nat × Bool :=
25	  match k with
26	  | .equalZero => (1,true)
27	  | .nonnegative => (if 0 < c then 0 else 2,false)
28	  | .positive => (if 0 < c then 2 else 0,true)
29	
30	def wantedBit (k : OrderTest) (c : Int) (positive : Bool) : Bool :=
31	  if positive then (request k c).2 else !(request k c).2
32	
33	def signedTerms (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) (c : Int) : List WeightedOperand :=
34	  [(c,.ordinary i F),(-c,.ordinary j G)]
35	
36	def source (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) (c : Int)
37	    (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) : Prop :=
38	  sourceTestAt f ρ 0 (signedTerms F G i j c) k.test positive
39	
40	def normCode : ValueField → Nat
41	  | .iterate _ => 0
42	  | .entry _ lam _ => rawNormCode (rawNoteEncode lam.1)
43	
44	/-- Both original domains keep their own literal norm guard; the existing
45	comparison cutoff is not silently treated as a field reader. -/
46	def minimum (B : Nat) (F G : ValueField) : Nat :=
47	  max (highFieldComparisonBoundCode B (longFieldCode F) (longFieldCode G))
48	    (max (normCode F) (normCode G))
49	
50	/-- Before the greatest raw value is assigned, use the same optional
51	genuine inverse-comparison operand and bare lower coordinate as the
52	existing stable sorted packet. Only the comparison is polarity-selected. -/
53	def strictPacket (F G : ValueField) (lo : Nat) (c : Int)
54	    (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) : Packet :=
55	  let base := basePacket F G lo (request k c).1
56	  (base.1 ++ [.coordinate lo],
57	    .conjunction (orderGuard (base.1.length+1))
58	      (choosePolarity base.2 (wantedBit k c positive)))
59	
60	def equalPacket (F G : ValueField) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) : Packet :=
61	  let answer := sameForm (normalizeShortField F) (normalizeShortField G)
62	  let base := HighFieldPreparedPacket.constantFormula 0 answer (request k c).1
63	  ([],choosePolarity base (wantedBit k c positive))
64	
65	def orientedPacket (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest)
66	    (positive : Bool) : Packet :=
67	  if i < j then strictPacket F G i c k positive
68	  else if j < i then strictPacket G F j (-c) k positive
69	  else equalPacket F G c k positive
70	
71	def ExactSignedPairValue : Prop :=
72	  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (F G : ValueField) (i j u v : Nat) (c : Int), c ≠ 0 →
73	    LowerOperandActual f ρ (.ordinary i F) u → LowerOperandActual f ρ (.ordinary j G) v →
74	    ∀ (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
75	      (source f ρ F G i j c k positive ↔
76	        if wantedBit k c positive then numericalComparison u v = (request k c).1
77	        else numericalComparison u v ≠ (request k c).1)
78	
79	def ExactStrictSignedPair : Prop :=
80	  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
81	  ∀ F G : ValueField, ProperField F → ProperField G →
82	  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (lo hi : Nat), lo < hi → minimum B F G ≤ ρ lo →
83	    ∀ (c : Int), c ≠ 0 → ∀ (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
84	      let packet := strictPacket F G lo c k positive
85	      PreparedInput packet.1 packet.2 ∧
86	      (∀ op ∈ packet.1, op.rank = lo) ∧
87	      (∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f hi ρ packet.1 ν ∧
88	        ∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < packet.1.length),
89	          lowerOperandRead f ρ packet.1[j] = some (some (ν (j+1)))) ∧
90	      ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat), PreparedTableTied f hi ρ packet.1 ν →
91	        ∀ z : Nat, ρ lo < z →
92	          let θ := Function.update ρ hi z
93	          ClosedOrdinaryValueDomain F (θ lo) ∧ ClosedOrdinaryValueDomain G (θ hi) ∧
94	          (∃ u v : Nat, lowerOperandRead f θ (.ordinary lo F) = some (some u) ∧
95	            lowerOperandRead f θ (.ordinary hi G) = some (some v)) ∧
96	          (packet.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z) ↔ source f θ F G lo hi c k positive)
97	
98	def ExactEqualRankSignedPair : Prop :=
99	  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
100	  ∀ F G : ValueField, ProperField F → ProperField G →
101	  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (rank : Nat) (c : Int), c ≠ 0 → ∀ (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
102	    let packet := equalPacket F G c k positive
103	    packet.1 = [] ∧ PreparedInput packet.1 packet.2 ∧
104	    ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat) (z : Nat), minimum B F G ≤ z →
105	      let θ := Function.update ρ rank z
106	      ClosedOrdinaryValueDomain F (θ rank) ∧ ClosedOrdinaryValueDomain G (θ rank) ∧
107	      (∃ u v : Nat, lowerOperandRead f θ (.ordinary rank F) = some (some u) ∧
108	        lowerOperandRead f θ (.ordinary rank G) = some (some v)) ∧
109	      (packet.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z) ↔ source f θ F G rank rank c k positive)
110	
111	def ExactReverseSignedPair : Prop :=
112	  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
113	    source f ρ G F j i (-c) k positive ↔ source f ρ F G i j c k positive
114	
115	def orientedMinimum (B : Nat) (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) : Nat :=
116	  if j < i then minimum B G F else minimum B F G
117	
118	/-- Genuine source orientation: when two ranks differ, the shorter
119	request packet is indexed by the original lower operand's rank. -/
120	def ExactOrientedSignedPair : Prop :=
121	  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
122	  ∀ F G : ValueField, ProperField F → ProperField G →
123	  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (i j : Nat) (c : Int), c ≠ 0 → ∀ (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
124	    let packet := orientedPacket F G i j c k positive
125	    let bound := orientedMinimum B F G i j
126	    (if i = j then True else bound ≤ ρ (min i j)) →
127	    PreparedInput packet.1 packet.2 ∧
128	    (∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f (max i j) ρ packet.1 ν) ∧
129	    ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat), PreparedTableTied f (max i j) ρ packet.1 ν →
130	      ∀ z : Nat, (if i = j then bound ≤ z else ρ (min i j) < z) →
131	        (packet.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z) ↔
132	          source f (Function.update ρ (max i j) z) F G i j c k positive)

134	def FullActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh : Prop :=
135	  ExactSignedPairValue ∧ ExactStrictSignedPair ∧ ExactEqualRankSignedPair ∧ ExactReverseSignedPair ∧
136	    ExactOrientedSignedPair
137	
138	end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StableSortedHighFieldTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormulaTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh
open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison PreparedProjection
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
open SignedRowGuardedTest (Test sourceTestAt)
open StableSortedHighField (Packet basePacket orderGuard)
open OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormula (choosePolarity)

inductive OrderTest where
  | equalZero | nonnegative | positive

def OrderTest.test : OrderTest → Test
  | .equalZero => .equalZero
  | .nonnegative => .nonnegative
  | .positive => .positive

/-- The exact requested comparison outcome and whether to assert it.
Zero weight is not admitted by the signed-pair theorem. -/
def request (k : OrderTest) (c : Int) : Nat × Bool :=
  match k with
  | .equalZero => (1,true)
  | .nonnegative => (if 0 < c then 0 else 2,false)
  | .positive => (if 0 < c then 2 else 0,true)

def wantedBit (k : OrderTest) (c : Int) (positive : Bool) : Bool :=
  if positive then (request k c).2 else !(request k c).2

def signedTerms (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) (c : Int) : List WeightedOperand :=
  [(c,.ordinary i F),(-c,.ordinary j G)]

def source (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) (c : Int)
    (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) : Prop :=
  sourceTestAt f ρ 0 (signedTerms F G i j c) k.test positive

def normCode : ValueField → Nat
  | .iterate _ => 0
  | .entry _ lam _ => rawNormCode (rawNoteEncode lam.1)

/-- Both original domains keep their own literal norm guard; the existing
comparison cutoff is not silently treated as a field reader. -/
def minimum (B : Nat) (F G : ValueField) : Nat :=
  max (highFieldComparisonBoundCode B (longFieldCode F) (longFieldCode G))
    (max (normCode F) (normCode G))

/-- Before the greatest raw value is assigned, use the same optional
genuine inverse-comparison operand and bare lower coordinate as the
existing stable sorted packet. Only the comparison is polarity-selected. -/
def strictPacket (F G : ValueField) (lo : Nat) (c : Int)
    (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) : Packet :=
  let base := basePacket F G lo (request k c).1
  (base.1 ++ [.coordinate lo],
    .conjunction (orderGuard (base.1.length+1))
      (choosePolarity base.2 (wantedBit k c positive)))

def equalPacket (F G : ValueField) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) : Packet :=
  let answer := sameForm (normalizeShortField F) (normalizeShortField G)
  let base := HighFieldPreparedPacket.constantFormula 0 answer (request k c).1
  ([],choosePolarity base (wantedBit k c positive))

def orientedPacket (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest)
    (positive : Bool) : Packet :=
  if i < j then strictPacket F G i c k positive
  else if j < i then strictPacket G F j (-c) k positive
  else equalPacket F G c k positive

def ExactSignedPairValue : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (F G : ValueField) (i j u v : Nat) (c : Int), c ≠ 0 →
    LowerOperandActual f ρ (.ordinary i F) u → LowerOperandActual f ρ (.ordinary j G) v →
    ∀ (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
      (source f ρ F G i j c k positive ↔
        if wantedBit k c positive then numericalComparison u v = (request k c).1
        else numericalComparison u v ≠ (request k c).1)

def ExactStrictSignedPair : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ F G : ValueField, ProperField F → ProperField G →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (lo hi : Nat), lo < hi → minimum B F G ≤ ρ lo →
    ∀ (c : Int), c ≠ 0 → ∀ (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
      let packet := strictPacket F G lo c k positive
      PreparedInput packet.1 packet.2 ∧
      (∀ op ∈ packet.1, op.rank = lo) ∧
      (∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f hi ρ packet.1 ν ∧
        ∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < packet.1.length),
          lowerOperandRead f ρ packet.1[j] = some (some (ν (j+1)))) ∧
      ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat), PreparedTableTied f hi ρ packet.1 ν →
        ∀ z : Nat, ρ lo < z →
          let θ := Function.update ρ hi z
          ClosedOrdinaryValueDomain F (θ lo) ∧ ClosedOrdinaryValueDomain G (θ hi) ∧
          (∃ u v : Nat, lowerOperandRead f θ (.ordinary lo F) = some (some u) ∧

  ∀ F G : ValueField, ProperField F → ProperField G →

    let packet := equalPacket F G c k positive
    packet.1 = [] ∧ PreparedInput packet.1 packet.2 ∧
    ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat) (z : Nat), minimum B F G ≤ z →
      let θ := Function.update ρ rank z
      ClosedOrdinaryValueDomain F (θ rank) ∧ ClosedOrdinaryValueDomain G (θ rank) ∧

        lowerOperandRead f θ (.ordinary rank G) = some (some v)) ∧
      (packet.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z) ↔ source f θ F G rank rank c k positive)

  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),

  if j < i then minimum B G F else minimum B F G

request packet is indexed by the original lower operand's rank. -/

  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ F G : ValueField, ProperField F → ProperField G →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (i j : Nat) (c : Int), c ≠ 0 → ∀ (k : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
    let packet := orientedPacket F G i j c k positive
    let bound := orientedMinimum B F G i j
    (if i = j then True else bound ≤ ρ (min i j)) →
    PreparedInput packet.1 packet.2 ∧
    (∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f (max i j) ρ packet.1 ν) ∧
    ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat), PreparedTableTied f (max i j) ρ packet.1 ν →
      ∀ z : Nat, (if i = j then bound ≤ z else ρ (min i j) < z) →
        (packet.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z) ↔
          source f (Function.update ρ (max i j) z) F G i j c k positive)

  ExactSignedPairValue ∧ ExactStrictSignedPair ∧ ExactEqualRankSignedPair ∧ ExactReverseSignedPair ∧
    ExactOrientedSignedPair

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.HighFieldPreparedActualTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StableSortedHighField
open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open PreparedProjection HighFieldPreparedPacket

abbrev Packet := List LowerOperand × NormalForm.Formula

/-- The original sorted descriptor supplies one fixed typed packet,
before the greater raw coordinate is assigned its value. -/
def basePacket (F G : ValueField) (lowRank wanted : Nat) : Packet :=
  if wanted ≤ 2 then
    match distinctForm (normalizeShortField F) (normalizeShortField G) with
    | .const answer => ([],constantFormula 0 answer wanted)
    | .linear sign H => ([.ordinary lowRank H],InverseComparisonPreparedRows.emitFormula sign wanted)
  else ([],.falsity)

/-- The real strict-order constraint is the signed row z - x - 1 ≥ 0. -/
def orderGuard (lowerName : Nat) : NormalForm.Formula :=
  .atom (.nonnegative (-1,[(1,.variable 0),(-1,.variable lowerName)]))

/-- Keep the base requests and append the original raw lower input.
Its own slot is used by the explicit strict-order guard. -/
def guardedPacket (F G : ValueField) (lowRank wanted : Nat) : Packet :=
  let base := basePacket F G lowRank wanted
  (base.1 ++ [.coordinate lowRank],.conjunction (orderGuard (base.1.length+1)) base.2)

def actualOutcome (f : Nat → Nat) (F G : ValueField) (x z wanted : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ vF vG : Nat, FieldValue f F x vF ∧ FieldValue f G z vG ∧ numericalComparison vF vG = wanted

def BasePacketExact : Prop :=
  ∀ (F G : ValueField) (lowRank highRank wanted : Nat), lowRank < highRank →
    let base := basePacket F G lowRank wanted
    compile (longFieldCode F,longFieldCode G,lowRank,highRank,wanted) =
        preparedPacketCode base.1 base.2 ∧
      PreparedInput base.1 base.2

def ActualGuardedPacket : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (F G : ValueField), ProperField F → ProperField G →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (lowRank highRank wanted : Nat), lowRank < highRank →
    highFieldComparisonBoundCode B (longFieldCode F) (longFieldCode G) ≤ ρ lowRank →
    let packet := guardedPacket F G lowRank wanted
    PreparedInput packet.1 packet.2 ∧
    (∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f highRank ρ packet.1 ν ∧
      ∀ (j : Nat) (used : j < packet.1.length),
        lowerOperandRead f ρ (packet.1.get ⟨j,used⟩) = some (some (ν (j+1)))) ∧
    (∀ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f highRank ρ packet.1 ν →
      (packet.2.eval ν ↔ ρ lowRank < ν 0 ∧ actualOutcome f F G (ρ lowRank) (ν 0) wanted))

def FullStableSortedHighField : Prop := BasePacketExact ∧ ActualGuardedPacket

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StableSortedHighField

/-- Successor-limit test on the existing raw notation code: nonzero code and
zero finite remainder of the existing raw split program. -/
def limitCode (n : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (0 < n) && decide (encodedOrdinalFiniteRemainder n = 0)

/-- Proper-interval test on the existing four-component field code
(tag, exponent, upper endpoint code, lower endpoint code). Tag zero is an
iterate; every nonzero tag is read as an entry, as `longFieldCode` documents. -/
def properFieldCode (c : LongFieldCode) : Bool :=
  if c.1 = 0 then true
  else (limitCode c.2.2.1 && (decide (c.2.2.2 = 0) || limitCode c.2.2.2)) &&
    decide (rawComparisonCode c.2.2.2 c.2.2.1 = 0)

/-- Operand test on the existing operand code (tag, rank, field code).
Tag zero is a raw coordinate; ordinary and count tags test their field code. -/

  if op.1 = 0 then true else properFieldCode op.2.2

def admittedRowCode (r : RawBitRow) : Bool :=
  admittedCode r.1.1 && r.1.2.2.all (fun t : WeightedCode => properOperandCode t.2)

def admittedClauseCode (rows : List RawBitRow) : Bool := rows.all admittedRowCode

/-- The raw proper-clause filter on encoded families. -/
def properClausesCode (family : RawFamily) : RawFamily := family.filter admittedClauseCode

def ExactLimitCode : Prop :=
  ∀ eta : NONote, limitCode (rawNoteEncode eta.1) = true ↔ Order.IsSuccLimit eta.1.repr

def ExactProperFieldCode : Prop :=
  ∀ F : ValueField, properFieldCode (longFieldCode F) = true ↔ ProperField F

def ExactProperOperandCode : Prop :=
  ∀ op : LowerOperand, properOperandCode op.code = true ↔ properOperand op

def ExactAdmittedTestCode : Prop :=
  ∀ t : Test, admittedCode (encodeTest t) = true ↔ t.Admitted

def ExactAdmittedRowCode : Prop :=
  ∀ row : BitRow, admittedRowCode (encodeBitRow row) = true ↔ AdmittedOperandRow row

def ExactAdmittedClauseCode : Prop :=
  ∀ rows : List BitRow,
    admittedClauseCode (rows.map encodeBitRow) = true ↔ AdmittedLiteralClause rows

/-- Literal list equation: the raw filter on the encoded family is the
encoding of the typed classical filter, in the same order. -/
def ExactRawProperClauses : Prop :=
  ∀ family : Family, properClausesCode (encodeFamily family) = encodeFamily (properClauses family)

/-- The operand code determines the operand (in particular the notations). -/
def ExactOperandCodeInjective : Prop :=
  ∀ op op' : LowerOperand, op.code = op'.code → op = op'

def ExactRawProperClauseEffectivity : Prop :=
  Primrec limitCode ∧ Primrec properFieldCode ∧ Primrec properOperandCode ∧
    Primrec admittedRowCode ∧ Primrec admittedClauseCode ∧ Primrec properClausesCode ∧
    Computable properClausesCode

def FullRawProperClause : Prop :=
  ExactLimitCode ∧ ExactProperFieldCode ∧ ExactProperOperandCode ∧ ExactAdmittedTestCode ∧
    ExactAdmittedRowCode ∧ ExactAdmittedClauseCode ∧ ExactRawProperClauses ∧
    ExactOperandCodeInjective ∧ ExactRawProperClauseEffectivity

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.RawProperClause

1	module
2	public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalOperandGroupingTargets
3	public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawComparisonCeilingTargets
4	public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRoutesTargets
5	
6	@[expose] public section
7	namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawCanonicalNodeMetadata
8	open PreparedProjection (LowerOperandCode)
9	open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
10	open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping (RawTerm encodeTerm groupRaw groupTyped)
11	open ActualRawComparisonCeiling (LabelCode encodeLabel labelCode)
12	open ActualFullValueLabels (activeLabel labels)
13	open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Answer)
14	open ActualFullValueMaximalMetadata (flags classFlags)
15	open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (activeTest)
16	
17	def activeLabelCode (t : RawTerm) : Option LabelCode :=
18	  if t.1 = 0 then none else labelCode t.2
19	
20	def labelsCode (ts : List RawTerm) : List LabelCode := ts.filterMap activeLabelCode
21	
22	def nonlinearCode (op : LowerOperandCode) : Bool :=
23	  if op.1 = 1 then
24	    if op.2.2.1 = 0 then decide (0 < op.2.2.2.1) else true
25	  else decide (op.1 = 2)
26	
27	def highestCode (top : Nat) (t : RawTerm) : Bool :=
28	  decide (t.1 ≠ 0 ∧ t.2.2.1 = top) && nonlinearCode t.2
29	
30	def tapeHighestCode (top : Nat) (ts : List RawTerm) : Bool := ts.any (highestCode top)
31	
32	def notLessCode (a : Nat) : Bool := decide (a ≠ 0)
33	
34	def flagsCode (w n : Nat) (as : List Nat) : List Bool :=

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalOperandGroupingTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawComparisonCeilingTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRoutesTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawCanonicalNodeMetadata
open PreparedProjection (LowerOperandCode)
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping (RawTerm encodeTerm groupRaw groupTyped)
open ActualRawComparisonCeiling (LabelCode encodeLabel labelCode)
open ActualFullValueLabels (activeLabel labels)
open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Answer)
open ActualFullValueMaximalMetadata (flags classFlags)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (activeTest)

def activeLabelCode (t : RawTerm) : Option LabelCode :=
  if t.1 = 0 then none else labelCode t.2

def labelsCode (ts : List RawTerm) : List LabelCode := ts.filterMap activeLabelCode

def nonlinearCode (op : LowerOperandCode) : Bool :=
  if op.1 = 1 then
    if op.2.2.1 = 0 then decide (0 < op.2.2.2.1) else true
  else decide (op.1 = 2)

def highestCode (top : Nat) (t : RawTerm) : Bool :=
  decide (t.1 ≠ 0 ∧ t.2.2.1 = top) && nonlinearCode t.2

def tapeHighestCode (top : Nat) (ts : List RawTerm) : Bool := ts.any (highestCode top)

def notLessCode (a : Nat) : Bool := decide (a ≠ 0)

def flagsCode (w n : Nat) (as : List Nat) : List Bool :=
  (List.range n).map (fun j => ((as.drop (j*w)).take w).all notLessCode)

def classFlagsCode (ts : List RawTerm) (as : List Nat) : List Bool :=
  let w := (labelsCode ts).length
  flagsCode w w as

def ExactRawActiveLabelTape : Prop :=
  (∀ t : WeightedOperand, activeLabelCode (encodeTerm t) = (activeLabel t).map encodeLabel) ∧
  ∀ ts : List WeightedOperand, labelsCode (ts.map encodeTerm) = (labels ts).map encodeLabel

def ExactRawHighestActivity : Prop :=
  (∀ (top : Nat) (t : WeightedOperand), highestCode top (encodeTerm t) = activeTest top t) ∧
  ∀ (top : Nat) (ts : List WeightedOperand),
    tapeHighestCode top (ts.map encodeTerm) = ts.any (activeTest top)

def ExactRawSuppliedAnswerFlags : Prop :=
  (∀ (w n : Nat) (as : List Answer),
      flagsCode w n (as.map Answer.code) = flags w n as) ∧
  ∀ (ts : List WeightedOperand) (as : List Answer),
    classFlagsCode (ts.map encodeTerm) (as.map Answer.code) = classFlags (labels ts) as

def ExactRawCanonicalNodeCalibration : Prop :=
  ∀ (top : Nat) (ts : List WeightedOperand) (as : List Answer),
    let raw := groupRaw (ts.map encodeTerm)
    let grouped := groupTyped ts
    labelsCode raw = (labels grouped).map encodeLabel ∧
    tapeHighestCode top raw = grouped.any (activeTest top) ∧
    classFlagsCode raw (as.map Answer.code) = classFlags (labels grouped) as

def ExactRawCanonicalNodeEffectivity : Prop :=
  Primrec activeLabelCode ∧ Primrec labelsCode ∧ Primrec₂ highestCode ∧
  Primrec₂ tapeHighestCode ∧
  Primrec (fun p : Nat × Nat × List Nat => flagsCode p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
  Primrec₂ classFlagsCode

def FullActualRawCanonicalNodeMetadata : Prop :=
  ExactRawActiveLabelTape ∧ ExactRawHighestActivity ∧ ExactRawSuppliedAnswerFlags ∧
    ExactRawCanonicalNodeCalibration ∧ ExactRawCanonicalNodeEffectivity

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawCanonicalNodeMetadata

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.HighFieldComparisonTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.InverseComparisonPreparedRowsTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.HighFieldPreparedPacket
open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open PreparedProjection

abbrev PostArgs := OrientedHighFormCode × Nat × Nat × Nat
abbrev Args := LongFieldCode × LongFieldCode × Nat × Nat × Nat

def lowerRank (orientation rankF rankG : Nat) : Nat :=
  if orientation = 0 then rankF else rankG

def sortedWanted (orientation wanted : Nat) : Nat :=
  if orientation = 0 then wanted else reverseComparisonCode wanted

def constantFormula (orientation answer wanted : Nat) : NormalForm.Formula :=
  if flipHighComparisonAnswer orientation answer = wanted then .truth else .falsity

/-- Keep the exact emitted lower operand code. A constant form has
an empty table, and a linear form has one genuine ordinary field request. -/
def postprocess (p : PostArgs) : PreparedPacketCode :=
  let (form,rankF,rankG,wanted) := p
  let (orientation,tag,answer,H) := form
  if wanted ≤ 2 then
    if tag = 0 then preparedPacketCode [] (constantFormula orientation answer wanted)
    else
      (Encodable.encode ([(1,lowerRank orientation rankF rankG,H)] : List LowerOperandCode),
        InverseComparisonPreparedRows.emitCode answer (sortedWanted orientation wanted))
  else preparedPacketCode [] .falsity

/-- This compiles on the actual chosen input ranks, before reading
the natural values of those ranks. -/
def compile (p : Args) : PreparedPacketCode :=
  let (F,G,rankF,rankG,wanted) := p
  postprocess (highRawComparisonForm F G rankF rankG,rankF,rankG,wanted)

def PostprocessEffective : Prop := Primrec postprocess

def PacketExact : Prop :=
  (∀ (form : OrientedHighFormCode) (rankF rankG wanted : Nat), 2 < wanted →
    postprocess (form,rankF,rankG,wanted) = preparedPacketCode [] .falsity) ∧
  (∀ (orientation c rankF rankG wanted : Nat), wanted ≤ 2 →
    postprocess ((orientation,rawConstForm c),rankF,rankG,wanted) =
      preparedPacketCode [] (constantFormula orientation c wanted)) ∧
  ∀ (orientation sign rankF rankG wanted : Nat) (H : ValueField), wanted ≤ 2 →
    postprocess ((orientation,rawLinearForm sign (longFieldCode H)),rankF,rankG,wanted) =
      preparedPacketCode [.ordinary (lowerRank orientation rankF rankG) H]
        (InverseComparisonPreparedRows.emitFormula sign (sortedWanted orientation wanted))

def PacketShape : Prop :=
  PreparedInput [] .falsity ∧
  (∀ orientation answer wanted, PreparedInput [] (constantFormula orientation answer wanted)) ∧
  ∀ (orientation sign rankF rankG wanted : Nat) (H : ValueField),
    PreparedInput [.ordinary (lowerRank orientation rankF rankG) H]
      (InverseComparisonPreparedRows.emitFormula sign (sortedWanted orientation wanted))

def FullHighFieldPreparedPostprocess : Prop :=
  PostprocessEffective ∧ PacketExact ∧ PacketShape

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.HighFieldPreparedPacket

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion.LinearRowsDefinitions

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion.LinearRows
open NormalForm

namespace Code
abbrev RowData := NormalForm.Code.RowData
abbrev AtomData := NormalForm.Code.AtomData
abbrev UnitAtomData := Nat × (Nat × (Int × RowData))

def rowConst (z : Int) : RowData := (z, [])
def rowAdd (r s : RowData) : RowData := (r.1 + s.1, r.2 ++ s.2)
def rowScale (z : Int) (r : RowData) : RowData :=
  (z * r.1, r.2.map (fun a => (z * a.1, a.2)))
def leading (i : Nat) (r : RowData) : Int :=
  (r.2.map (fun a => if a.2.2.1 = i then a.1 else 0)).sum
def remainder (i : Nat) (r : RowData) : RowData :=
  (r.1, r.2.filter (fun a => a.2.2.1 != i))
def rowLinear (i : Nat) (r : RowData) : Bool :=
  r.2.all (fun a => a.2.1 == 0 || a.2.2.1 != i)
def decodeAtom (payload : Nat) : AtomData :=
  (Encodable.decode payload).getD (0, 0, (0 : Int), [])
def decodeUnit (payload : Nat) : UnitAtomData :=
  (Encodable.decode payload).getD (0, 0, (0 : Int), (0 : Int), [])

/-- A total structural map on the original radix-six Boolean encoding. -/
def mapAtoms (op : Nat → Nat) (code : Nat) : Nat :=
  if code % 6 = 0 then 0 else if code % 6 = 1 then 1
  else if code % 6 = 2 then 6 * op (code / 6) + 2
  else if code % 6 = 3 then 6 * mapAtoms op (code / 6) + 3
  else 6 * Nat.pair (mapAtoms op (code / 6).unpair.1)
    (mapAtoms op (code / 6).unpair.2) + code % 6
termination_by code
decreasing_by
  all_goals
    have hpos : 0 < code := by omega
    have hd : code / 6 < code := Nat.div_lt_self hpos (by decide)
    have hl := Nat.unpair_left_le (code / 6)
    have hr := Nat.unpair_right_le (code / 6)
    omega

def atoms (code : Nat) : List Nat :=
  if code % 6 = 0 then [] else if code % 6 = 1 then []
  else if code % 6 = 2 then [code / 6]
  else if code % 6 = 3 then atoms (code / 6)
  else atoms (code / 6).unpair.1 ++ atoms (code / 6).unpair.2
termination_by code
decreasing_by
  all_goals
    have hpos : 0 < code := by omega
    have hd : code / 6 < code := Nat.div_lt_self hpos (by decide)
    have hl := Nat.unpair_left_le (code / 6)
    have hr := Nat.unpair_right_le (code / 6)
    omega

def isLinear (i code : Nat) : Bool := (atoms code).all (fun a => rowLinear i (decodeAtom a).2.2)
def conjunction (p q : Nat) : Nat := 6 * Nat.pair p q + 4
def unitAtom (a : UnitAtomData) : Nat := 6 * Encodable.encode a + 2
def weight (i : Nat) (a : AtomData) : Nat :=
  if leading i a.2.2 = 0 then 1 else (leading i a.2.2).natAbs
def coefficientModulus (i code : Nat) : Nat :=
  ((atoms code).map (fun a => weight i (decodeAtom a))).prod
def nonzeroSign (z : Int) : Int := if 0 < z then 1 else -1
def adjustAtom (i M : Nat) (a : AtomData) : UnitAtomData :=
  let z := leading i a.2.2
  let r := remainder i a.2.2
  if z = 0 then (a.1, a.2.1, 0, r)
  else let k := M / z.natAbs
    (a.1, if a.1 = 0 then 0 else (a.2.1 + 1) * k - 1,
      nonzeroSign z, rowScale (k : Int) r)
def adjust (i M code : Nat) : Nat :=
  mapAtoms (fun a => Encodable.encode (adjustAtom i M (decodeAtom a))) code
def normalize (i code : Nat) : Nat :=
  let M := coefficientModulus i code
  conjunction (unitAtom (1, M - 1, 1, rowConst 0)) (adjust i M code)
def atomPeriod (a : UnitAtomData) : Nat := if a.1 = 0 then 1 else a.2.1 + 1
def atomCutoffs (a : UnitAtomData) : List RowData :=
  if a.1 = 0 then
    if a.2.2.1 = 1 then [rowScale (-1) a.2.2.2]
    else if a.2.2.1 = -1 then [rowAdd a.2.2.2 (rowConst 1)] else []
  else []
def period (code : Nat) : Nat := ((atoms code).map (fun a => atomPeriod (decodeUnit a))).prod
def cutoffs (code : Nat) : List RowData :=
  rowConst 0 :: (atoms code).flatMap (fun a => atomCutoffs (decodeUnit a))
def instantiateAtom (b : RowData) (a : UnitAtomData) : AtomData :=
  (a.1, a.2.1, rowAdd (rowScale a.2.2.1 b) a.2.2.2)
def instantiate (code : Nat) (b : RowData) : Nat :=
  mapAtoms (fun a => Encodable.encode (instantiateAtom b (decodeUnit a))) code
def guarded (code : Nat) : Nat := conjunction (unitAtom (0, 0, 1, rowConst 0)) code
def unitEliminate (code : Nat) : Nat :=
  BoundedRows.Code.any ((cutoffs code).flatMap (fun b => (List.range (period code)).map
    (fun j => instantiate (guarded code) (rowAdd b (rowConst (j : Int))))))
def eliminate (i code : Nat) : Nat := unitEliminate (normalize i code)
end Code

def UnitAtom.data : UnitAtom → Code.UnitAtomData
  | .nonnegative s r => (0, 0, s.value, rowData r)
  | .divisible m s r => (1, m, s.value, rowData r)
def unitEncode : UnitFormula → Nat
  | .top => 0
  | .bot => 1
  | .atom a => 6 * Encodable.encode a.data + 2
  | .neg p => 6 * unitEncode p + 3
  | .conj p q => 6 * Nat.pair (unitEncode p) (unitEncode q) + 4
  | .disj p q => 6 * Nat.pair (unitEncode p) (unitEncode q) + 5

end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion.LinearRows

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawCanonicalNodeMetadataTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawCanonicalAnswerTapes
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping (RawTerm groupRaw groupTyped encodeTerm)
open ActualRawCanonicalNodeMetadata (labelsCode)
open ActualFullValueLabels (labels)
open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Answer)
open ActualFiniteFullValueGuards (pairs patterns)

def answerTapes : Nat → List (List Nat)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n+1 => [0,1,2].flatMap (fun a => (answerTapes n).map (List.cons a))

def pairWidth (terms : List RawTerm) : Nat :=
  let n := (labelsCode terms).length
  n * n

def candidateTapes (terms : List RawTerm) : List (List Nat) := answerTapes (pairWidth terms)

def ExactRawAnswerTapeEnumeration : Prop :=
  (∀ n : Nat, answerTapes n = (patterns n).map (List.map Answer.code)) ∧
  ∀ (n : Nat) (tape : List Nat), tape ∈ answerTapes n →
    tape.length = n ∧ ∀ a ∈ tape, a < 3

def ExactCanonicalAnswerPairs : Prop :=
  (∀ terms : List WeightedOperand,
    pairWidth (terms.map encodeTerm) = (pairs (labels terms)).length ∧
    candidateTapes (terms.map encodeTerm) = (patterns (pairs (labels terms)).length).map (List.map Answer.code)) ∧
  ∀ ts : List WeightedOperand,
    let grouped := groupTyped ts
    let raw := groupRaw (ts.map encodeTerm)
    pairWidth raw = (pairs (labels grouped)).length ∧
    candidateTapes raw = (patterns (pairs (labels grouped)).length).map (List.map Answer.code)

def ExactRawAnswerTapeEffectivity : Prop :=
  Primrec answerTapes ∧ Primrec pairWidth ∧ Primrec candidateTapes

def FullActualRawCanonicalAnswerTapes : Prop :=
  ExactRawAnswerTapeEnumeration ∧ ExactCanonicalAnswerPairs ∧ ExactRawAnswerTapeEffectivity

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawCanonicalAnswerTapes

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackLevelOrderTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalRoutesLayoutProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalSupplierProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplierContractProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackLevelOrder
open OrdinalComparison
open StageCallbackSupplier (Supplier SupplierShape SupplierExact stageChildren Emits
  exactSuppliedStageCallback)
open StageCallbackCanonicalRoutes (CanonicalActive tapes guard routes linearRoute signedRoute
  exactCanonicalRouteLayout)
open StageCallbackCanonicalSupplier (canonical exactCanonicalSupplierShape
  exactCanonicalSupplierExact)
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping (groupTyped)
open ActualCanonicalSymbolicZeroSuccessor (canonicalSuccessor)
open ActualCanonicalTerminalTruth (canonicalPacket)
open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Answer)
open ActualFullValueMaximalMetadata (maximalCoefficient)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest)
open ActualInitialSignedCountCleanup (cleanup)
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (Route prefixGuard)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (packet)
open ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples (MixedRow)
open ActualSyntaxChargeBudget (syntaxBudget)

/-- A route read below a prefix of guards already met. -/
def pfx (pre : List Packet) (ρ : Route) : Route := ⟨pre ++ ρ.guards,ρ.tip⟩

theorem pfx_nil (ρ : Route) : pfx [] ρ = ρ := by
  cases ρ
  rfl

/-- The frontier grown from an arbitrary list of entries. -/
noncomputable def grow (top : Nat) (es : List Entry) : Nat → List Entry
  | 0 => es
  | n+1 => (grow top es n).flatMap (children top)

theorem level_eq_grow (top : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (n : Nat) :
    level top s n = grow top [([],s)] n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      show (level top s n).flatMap (children top) = (grow top [([],s)] n).flatMap (children top)
      rw [ih]

/-- First-step decomposition of the frontier of one entry. -/
theorem mem_grow_succ (top : Nat) (e : Entry) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ x : Entry, x ∈ grow top [e] (n+1) ↔ ∃ c ∈ children top e, x ∈ grow top [c] n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro x
      constructor
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨y,hy,hx⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp h
        have same : y = e := List.mem_singleton.mp hy
        rw [same] at hx
        exact ⟨x,hx,List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨c,hc,hx⟩
        have same : x = c := List.mem_singleton.mp hx
        rw [same]
        exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨e,List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,hc⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      constructor
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨y,hy,hx⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp h
        obtain ⟨c,hc,hy'⟩ := (ih y).mp hy
        exact ⟨c,hc,List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨y,hy',hx⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨c,hc,h⟩
        obtain ⟨y,hy,hx⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp h
        exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨y,(ih y).mpr ⟨c,hc,hy⟩,hx⟩

theorem stepOf_zero (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer)
    (h : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0) :
    stepOf top (pre,s) a = (canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms a).map
      (fun out => (pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],out)) := if_pos h

theorem stepOf_nonzero (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer)
    (h : ¬ maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0) :
    stepOf top (pre,s) a = none := if_neg h

theorem leafOf_zero (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer)
    (h : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0) :
    leafOf top (pre,s) a = none := if_pos h

theorem leafOf_nonzero (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer)
    (h : ¬ maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0) :
    leafOf top (pre,s) a = some ⟨pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],
      .signed (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a)⟩ := if_neg h

theorem children_active (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState)
    (h : CanonicalActive top s.terms) :
    children top (pre,s) = (tapes (groupTyped s.terms)).filterMap (stepOf top (pre,s)) :=
  if_pos h

theorem children_idle (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState)
    (h : ¬ CanonicalActive top s.terms) : children top (pre,s) = [] := if_neg h

theorem leaves_active (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (pre : List Packet)
    (s : SyntaxState) (h : CanonicalActive top s.terms) :
    leaves top test positive (pre,s) =
      (tapes (groupTyped s.terms)).filterMap (leafOf top (pre,s)) := if_pos h

theorem leaves_idle (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (pre : List Packet)
    (s : SyntaxState) (h : ¬ CanonicalActive top s.terms) :
    leaves top test positive (pre,s) =
      [⟨pre,.linear (canonicalPacket top s.constant s.terms test.test positive)⟩] := if_neg h

theorem pfx_linear (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (pre : List Packet)
    (s : SyntaxState) :
    pfx pre (linearRoute top test positive s) =
      ⟨pre,.linear (canonicalPacket top s.constant s.terms test.test positive)⟩ := by
  simp [pfx,linearRoute]

theorem pfx_signed (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer) :
    pfx pre (signedRoute top s a) = ⟨pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],
      .signed (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a)⟩ := rfl

theorem pfx_step (pre : List Packet) (g : Packet) (tail : Route) :
    pfx pre (prefixGuard g tail) = pfx (pre ++ [g]) tail := by
  simp [pfx,prefixGuard]

/-- Leaves reachable within `n` level steps from an entry are exactly the
tree routes at fuel `n` from its syntax, read below its guards. -/
theorem reachLeaves (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (route : Route),
      (∃ k, k ≤ n ∧ ∃ y ∈ grow top [(pre,s)] k, route ∈ leaves top test positive y) ↔
        ∃ ρ ∈ routes top test positive n s, route = pfx pre ρ := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro pre s route
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k,hk,y,hy,hleaf⟩
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          have ye : y = (pre,s) := List.mem_singleton.mp hy
          rw [ye] at hleaf
          by_cases active : CanonicalActive top s.terms
          · rw [leaves_active top test positive pre s active] at hleaf
            obtain ⟨a,ha,hl⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hleaf
            by_cases zero : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0
            · rw [leafOf_zero top pre s a zero] at hl
              cases hl
            · rw [leafOf_nonzero top pre s a zero] at hl
              have eq := Option.some.inj hl
              exact ⟨signedRoute top s a,
                (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top n test positive s _).mpr
                  (Or.inr ⟨active,a,ha,Or.inl ⟨zero,rfl⟩⟩),
                eq.symm.trans (pfx_signed top pre s a).symm⟩
          · rw [leaves_idle top test positive pre s active] at hleaf
            have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp hleaf
            exact ⟨linearRoute top test positive s,
              (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top n test positive s _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨active,rfl⟩),
              eq.trans (pfx_linear top test positive pre s).symm⟩
      | succ j =>
          obtain ⟨c,hc,hy'⟩ := (mem_grow_succ top (pre,s) j y).mp hy
          by_cases active : CanonicalActive top s.terms
          · rw [children_active top pre s active] at hc
            obtain ⟨a,ha,hstep⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hc
            by_cases zero : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0
            · rw [stepOf_zero top pre s a zero] at hstep
              cases produced : canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms a with
              | none =>
                  rw [produced] at hstep
                  cases hstep
              | some out =>
                  rw [produced] at hstep
                  have ce : (pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],out) = c :=
                    Option.some.inj hstep
                  rw [← ce] at hy'
                  have depth : n = (n-1)+1 := by omega
                  obtain ⟨tail,htail,eq⟩ := (ih (n-1) (by omega)
                    (pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a]) out route).mp
                    ⟨j,by omega,y,hy',hleaf⟩
                  exact ⟨prefixGuard (guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a) tail,
                    (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top n test positive s _).mpr
                      (Or.inr ⟨active,a,ha,Or.inr ⟨zero,n-1,out,depth,produced,tail,htail,rfl⟩⟩),
                    eq.trans (pfx_step pre _ tail).symm⟩
            · rw [stepOf_nonzero top pre s a zero] at hstep
              cases hstep
          · rw [children_idle top pre s active] at hc
            cases hc
    · rintro ⟨ρ,hρ,rfl⟩
      rcases (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top n test positive s ρ).mp hρ with
        ⟨idle,rfl⟩ | ⟨active,a,ha,branches⟩
      · refine ⟨0,Nat.zero_le _,(pre,s),List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,?_⟩
        rw [leaves_idle top test positive pre s idle,pfx_linear]
        exact List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
      · rcases branches with ⟨nonzero,rfl⟩ | ⟨zero,k,out,depth,success,tail,htail,rfl⟩
        · refine ⟨0,Nat.zero_le _,(pre,s),List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,?_⟩

            refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨a,ha,?_⟩

            exact hleaf

      q ∈ StageCallbackCanonicalSupplier.alternatives r top (.signed ⟨src,test,positive⟩) := by

  · intro h
    obtain ⟨route,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨route,
      (exactLevelOrderRoutes top test positive (syntaxBudget r src.terms) src route).mp member,rfl⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨route,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨route,

  intro r top row q
  rcases row with ⟨⟨test,c,ts⟩,bit⟩
  cases test with

  intro alt alt' same

    exact ⟨q,(same r top row q).mpr used,holds⟩
  · rintro ⟨q,used,holds⟩
    exact ⟨q,(same r top row q).mp used,holds⟩

  (exactSupplierMemberTransfer canonical levelOrder exactLevelOrderMembers).1
    exactCanonicalSupplierShape

  intro f B selected
  exact (exactSupplierMemberTransfer canonical levelOrder exactLevelOrderMembers).2 f B
    (exactCanonicalSupplierExact f B selected)

  intro f B selected high emits
  exact exactSuppliedStageCallback f B levelOrder exactLevelOrderSupplierShape

/-- A route read below a prefix of guards already met. -/
def pfx (pre : List Packet) (ρ : Route) : Route := ⟨pre ++ ρ.guards,ρ.tip⟩

theorem pfx_nil (ρ : Route) : pfx [] ρ = ρ := by
  cases ρ
  rfl

/-- The frontier grown from an arbitrary list of entries. -/
noncomputable def grow (top : Nat) (es : List Entry) : Nat → List Entry
  | 0 => es
  | n+1 => (grow top es n).flatMap (children top)

theorem level_eq_grow (top : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (n : Nat) :
    level top s n = grow top [([],s)] n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      show (level top s n).flatMap (children top) = (grow top [([],s)] n).flatMap (children top)
      rw [ih]

/-- First-step decomposition of the frontier of one entry. -/
theorem mem_grow_succ (top : Nat) (e : Entry) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ x : Entry, x ∈ grow top [e] (n+1) ↔ ∃ c ∈ children top e, x ∈ grow top [c] n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro x
      constructor
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨y,hy,hx⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp h
        have same : y = e := List.mem_singleton.mp hy
        rw [same] at hx
        exact ⟨x,hx,List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨c,hc,hx⟩
        have same : x = c := List.mem_singleton.mp hx
        rw [same]
        exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨e,List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,hc⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      constructor
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨y,hy,hx⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp h
        obtain ⟨c,hc,hy'⟩ := (ih y).mp hy
        exact ⟨c,hc,List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨y,hy',hx⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨c,hc,h⟩
        obtain ⟨y,hy,hx⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp h
        exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨y,(ih y).mpr ⟨c,hc,hy⟩,hx⟩

    (h : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0) :
    stepOf top (pre,s) a = (canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms a).map
      (fun out => (pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],out)) := if_pos h

    (h : ¬ maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0) :

    (h : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0) :
    leafOf top (pre,s) a = none := if_pos h

theorem leafOf_nonzero (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer)
    (h : ¬ maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0) :
    leafOf top (pre,s) a = some ⟨pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],
      .signed (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a)⟩ := if_neg h

    (h : CanonicalActive top s.terms) :
    children top (pre,s) = (tapes (groupTyped s.terms)).filterMap (stepOf top (pre,s)) :=
  if_pos h

theorem children_idle (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState)
    (h : ¬ CanonicalActive top s.terms) : children top (pre,s) = [] := if_neg h

theorem leaves_active (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (pre : List Packet)
    (s : SyntaxState) (h : CanonicalActive top s.terms) :
    leaves top test positive (pre,s) =
      (tapes (groupTyped s.terms)).filterMap (leafOf top (pre,s)) := if_pos h

theorem leaves_idle (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (pre : List Packet)
    (s : SyntaxState) (h : ¬ CanonicalActive top s.terms) :
    leaves top test positive (pre,s) =
      [⟨pre,.linear (canonicalPacket top s.constant s.terms test.test positive)⟩] := if_neg h

    (s : SyntaxState) :

      ⟨pre,.linear (canonicalPacket top s.constant s.terms test.test positive)⟩ := by
  simp [pfx,linearRoute]

theorem pfx_signed (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer) :
    pfx pre (signedRoute top s a) = ⟨pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],
      .signed (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a)⟩ := rfl

    pfx pre (prefixGuard g tail) = pfx (pre ++ [g]) tail := by
  simp [pfx,prefixGuard]

    ∀ (n : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (route : Route),

  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro pre s route
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k,hk,y,hy,hleaf⟩
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          have ye : y = (pre,s) := List.mem_singleton.mp hy
          rw [ye] at hleaf
          by_cases active : CanonicalActive top s.terms
          · rw [leaves_active top test positive pre s active] at hleaf
            obtain ⟨a,ha,hl⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hleaf
            by_cases zero : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0
            · rw [leafOf_zero top pre s a zero] at hl
              cases hl
            · rw [leafOf_nonzero top pre s a zero] at hl
              have eq := Option.some.inj hl
              exact ⟨signedRoute top s a,
                (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top n test positive s _).mpr
                  (Or.inr ⟨active,a,ha,Or.inl ⟨zero,rfl⟩⟩),
                eq.symm.trans (pfx_signed top pre s a).symm⟩
          · rw [leaves_idle top test positive pre s active] at hleaf
            have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp hleaf
            exact ⟨linearRoute top test positive s,
              (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top n test positive s _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨active,rfl⟩),
              eq.trans (pfx_linear top test positive pre s).symm⟩

          obtain ⟨c,hc,hy'⟩ := (mem_grow_succ top (pre,s) j y).mp hy
          by_cases active : CanonicalActive top s.terms
          · rw [children_active top pre s active] at hc
            obtain ⟨a,ha,hstep⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hc
            by_cases zero : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0

                  exact ⟨prefixGuard (guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a) tail,

                      (Or.inr ⟨active,a,ha,Or.inr ⟨zero,n-1,out,depth,produced,tail,htail,rfl⟩⟩),
                    eq.trans (pfx_step pre _ tail).symm⟩
            · rw [stepOf_nonzero top pre s a zero] at hstep

        · refine ⟨0,Nat.zero_le _,(pre,s),List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,?_⟩

            (leafOf_nonzero top pre s a nonzero).trans (congrArg some (pfx_signed top pre s a).symm)⟩
        · obtain ⟨j,hj,y,hy,hleaf⟩ := (ih k (by omega)
            (pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a]) out
            (pfx (pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a]) tail)).mpr ⟨tail,htail,rfl⟩
          refine ⟨j+1,by omega,y,(mem_grow_succ top (pre,s) j y).mpr
            ⟨(pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],out),?_,hy⟩,?_⟩
          · rw [children_active top pre s active]
            refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨a,ha,?_⟩
            rw [stepOf_zero top pre s a zero,success]
            rfl
          · rw [pfx_step]
            exact hleaf

    obtain ⟨y,hy,hleaf⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hroute
    rw [level_eq_grow] at hy

    exactCanonicalSupplierShape

    (exactCanonicalSupplierExact f B selected)

theorem leafOf_zero (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer)
    (h : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0) :
    leafOf top (pre,s) a = none := if_pos h

theorem leafOf_nonzero (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer)
    (h : ¬ maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0) :
    leafOf top (pre,s) a = some ⟨pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],
      .signed (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a)⟩ := if_neg h

theorem children_active (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState)
    (h : CanonicalActive top s.terms) :
    children top (pre,s) = (tapes (groupTyped s.terms)).filterMap (stepOf top (pre,s)) :=
  if_pos h

theorem children_idle (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState)
    (h : ¬ CanonicalActive top s.terms) : children top (pre,s) = [] := if_neg h

theorem leaves_active (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (pre : List Packet)
    (s : SyntaxState) (h : CanonicalActive top s.terms) :
    leaves top test positive (pre,s) =
      (tapes (groupTyped s.terms)).filterMap (leafOf top (pre,s)) := if_pos h

theorem leaves_idle (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (pre : List Packet)
    (s : SyntaxState) (h : ¬ CanonicalActive top s.terms) :
    leaves top test positive (pre,s) =
      [⟨pre,.linear (canonicalPacket top s.constant s.terms test.test positive)⟩] := if_neg h

theorem pfx_linear (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (pre : List Packet)
    (s : SyntaxState) :
    pfx pre (linearRoute top test positive s) =
      ⟨pre,.linear (canonicalPacket top s.constant s.terms test.test positive)⟩ := by
  simp [pfx,linearRoute]

theorem pfx_signed (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer) :
    pfx pre (signedRoute top s a) = ⟨pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],
      .signed (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a)⟩ := rfl

theorem pfx_step (pre : List Packet) (g : Packet) (tail : Route) :
    pfx pre (prefixGuard g tail) = pfx (pre ++ [g]) tail := by
  simp [pfx,prefixGuard]

/-- Leaves reachable within `n` level steps from an entry are exactly the
tree routes at fuel `n` from its syntax, read below its guards. -/
theorem reachLeaves (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (route : Route),
      (∃ k, k ≤ n ∧ ∃ y ∈ grow top [(pre,s)] k, route ∈ leaves top test positive y) ↔
        ∃ ρ ∈ routes top test positive n s, route = pfx pre ρ := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro pre s route
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k,hk,y,hy,hleaf⟩
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          have ye : y = (pre,s) := List.mem_singleton.mp hy
          rw [ye] at hleaf
          by_cases active : CanonicalActive top s.terms
          · rw [leaves_active top test positive pre s active] at hleaf
            obtain ⟨a,ha,hl⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hleaf
            by_cases zero : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0
            · rw [leafOf_zero top pre s a zero] at hl
              cases hl
            · rw [leafOf_nonzero top pre s a zero] at hl
              have eq := Option.some.inj hl
              exact ⟨signedRoute top s a,
                (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top n test positive s _).mpr
                  (Or.inr ⟨active,a,ha,Or.inl ⟨zero,rfl⟩⟩),
                eq.symm.trans (pfx_signed top pre s a).symm⟩
          · rw [leaves_idle top test positive pre s active] at hleaf
            have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp hleaf
            exact ⟨linearRoute top test positive s,
              (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top n test positive s _).mpr (Or.inl ⟨active,rfl⟩),
              eq.trans (pfx_linear top test positive pre s).symm⟩
      | succ j =>
          obtain ⟨c,hc,hy'⟩ := (mem_grow_succ top (pre,s) j y).mp hy
          by_cases active : CanonicalActive top s.terms
          · rw [children_active top pre s active] at hc
            obtain ⟨a,ha,hstep⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hc
            by_cases zero : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0
            · rw [stepOf_zero top pre s a zero] at hstep
              cases produced : canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms a with
              | none =>
                  rw [produced] at hstep
                  cases hstep
              | some out =>
                  rw [produced] at hstep
                  have ce : (pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],out) = c :=
                    Option.some.inj hstep
                  rw [← ce] at hy'
                  have depth : n = (n-1)+1 := by omega
                  obtain ⟨tail,htail,eq⟩ := (ih (n-1) (by omega)
                    (pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a]) out route).mp
                    ⟨j,by omega,y,hy',hleaf⟩
                  exact ⟨prefixGuard (guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a) tail,
                    (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top n test positive s _).mpr
                      (Or.inr ⟨active,a,ha,Or.inr ⟨zero,n-1,out,depth,produced,tail,htail,rfl⟩⟩),
                    eq.trans (pfx_step pre _ tail).symm⟩
            · rw [stepOf_nonzero top pre s a zero] at hstep
              cases hstep
          · rw [children_idle top pre s active] at hc
            cases hc
    · rintro ⟨ρ,hρ,rfl⟩
      rcases (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top n test positive s ρ).mp hρ with
        ⟨idle,rfl⟩ | ⟨active,a,ha,branches⟩
      · refine ⟨0,Nat.zero_le _,(pre,s),List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,?_⟩
        rw [leaves_idle top test positive pre s idle,pfx_linear]
        exact List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
      · rcases branches with ⟨nonzero,rfl⟩ | ⟨zero,k,out,depth,success,tail,htail,rfl⟩
        · refine ⟨0,Nat.zero_le _,(pre,s),List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,?_⟩
          rw [leaves_active top test positive pre s active]
          exact List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨a,ha,
            (leafOf_nonzero top pre s a nonzero).trans (congrArg some (pfx_signed top pre s a).symm)⟩
        · obtain ⟨j,hj,y,hy,hleaf⟩ := (ih k (by omega)
            (pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a]) out
            (pfx (pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a]) tail)).mpr ⟨tail,htail,rfl⟩
          refine ⟨j+1,by omega,y,(mem_grow_succ top (pre,s) j y).mpr
            ⟨(pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],out),?_,hy⟩,?_⟩
          · rw [children_active top pre s active]
            refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨a,ha,?_⟩
            rw [stepOf_zero top pre s a zero,success]
            rfl
          · rw [pfx_step]
            exact hleaf

theorem exactLevelOrderRoutes : ExactLevelOrderRoutes := by
  intro top test positive fuel s route
  have key := reachLeaves top test positive fuel [] s route
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨k,hk,hroute⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp h
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hleaf⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hroute
    rw [level_eq_grow] at hy
    obtain ⟨ρ,hρ,eq⟩ := key.mp ⟨k,Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (List.mem_range.mp hk),y,hy,hleaf⟩
    rw [eq,pfx_nil]
    exact hρ
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨k,hk,y,hy,hleaf⟩ := key.mpr ⟨route,h,(pfx_nil route).symm⟩
    refine List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨k,List.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk),
      List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨y,?_,hleaf⟩⟩
    rw [level_eq_grow]
    exact hy

theorem signedMembers (r top : Nat) (src : SyntaxState) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool)
    (q : Packet) :
    q ∈ alternatives r top (.signed ⟨src,test,positive⟩) ↔
      q ∈ StageCallbackCanonicalSupplier.alternatives r top (.signed ⟨src,test,positive⟩) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨route,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨route,
      (exactLevelOrderRoutes top test positive (syntaxBudget r src.terms) src route).mp member,rfl⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨route,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨route,
      (exactLevelOrderRoutes top test positive (syntaxBudget r src.terms) src route).mpr member,rfl⟩

theorem exactLevelOrderMembers : ExactLevelOrderMembers := by
  intro r top row q
  rcases row with ⟨⟨test,c,ts⟩,bit⟩
  cases test with
  | equalZero => exact signedMembers r top (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩) .equalZero bit q
  | nonnegative => exact signedMembers r top (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩) .nonnegative bit q
  | positive => exact signedMembers r top (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩) .positive bit q
  | congruence m => exact Iff.rfl

theorem exactSupplierMemberTransfer : ExactSupplierMemberTransfer := by
  intro alt alt' same
  refine ⟨fun shaped r top row q used => shaped r top row q ((same r top row q).mp used),?_⟩
  intro f B rowwise r top baseline row z admitted strict scope lower high
  refine (rowwise r top baseline row z admitted strict scope lower high).trans ?_
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q,used,holds⟩
    exact ⟨q,(same r top row q).mpr used,holds⟩
  · rintro ⟨q,used,holds⟩
    exact ⟨q,(same r top row q).mp used,holds⟩

theorem exactLevelOrderSupplierShape : ExactLevelOrderSupplierShape :=
  (exactSupplierMemberTransfer canonical levelOrder exactLevelOrderMembers).1
    exactCanonicalSupplierShape

theorem exactLevelOrderSupplierExact : ExactLevelOrderSupplierExact := by
  intro f B selected
  exact (exactSupplierMemberTransfer canonical levelOrder exactLevelOrderMembers).2 f B
    (exactCanonicalSupplierExact f B selected)

theorem exactLevelOrderStageCallback : ExactLevelOrderStageCallback := by
  intro f B selected high emits
  exact exactSuppliedStageCallback f B levelOrder exactLevelOrderSupplierShape
    (exactLevelOrderSupplierExact f B selected) high emits

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackLevelOrder

# Paper 17: the canonical supplier in the list order of a raw level iteration

Key: `STAGE-CALLBACK-LEVEL-ORDER`. Targets module
`LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackLevelOrderTargets`.

Printed source: `17-permitted-control-canonical-comparison/sections/arithmetic.tex`,
`thm:arithmetic`: "Each node has finite branching. Thus the entire symbolic normalization tree can be
generated before numerical tails are chosen." This key fixes *how* that tree is listed so that a raw
program can list it the same way; it adds no new semantics.

## Why

`Emits alt B high` is a literal list equation. #1395's `canonical` lists a signed row's alternatives
depth-first, by a recursion in which the fuel-`n+1` tree calls the fuel-`n` tree at varying syntax.
A primitive recursive raw program iterates one level step on a list instead (as the accepted
`ActualRawCanonicalZeroPrefixes.level` does). The close step needs one supplier whose list is the one
that iteration produces.

## What is stated

- `Entry = List Packet × SyntaxState` (guards met so far in path order, current syntax): the typed
  shadow of a raw entry (list of packet codes, raw syntax).
- `children top e`: the zero-edge successors of an entry, **only if** its syntax is active at `top`
  (the test the accepted raw step lacks); `leaves top test positive e`: its linear exit if inactive,
  its nonzero-tape signed leaves if active; `level` iterates `children` by `flatMap`;
  `levelRoutes fuel` lists the leaves of levels `0,…,fuel`.
- `levelOrder`: signed rows get `(levelRoutes …).map (packet …)` at the syntax budget of the cleaned
  syntax; congruence rows keep the accepted packet.

Targets: `ExactLevelOrderRoutes` (same routes as the #1394 tree, as sets),
`ExactLevelOrderMembers` (same packets as #1395's `canonical`, per row),
`ExactSupplierMemberTransfer` (shape and exactness of a supplier depend on membership only),
`ExactLevelOrderSupplierShape`, `ExactLevelOrderSupplierExact`, and
`ExactLevelOrderStageCallback`:
`Emits levelOrder B high → HighAtStage f B high (stageChildren levelOrder B)`.

## What is assumed

`SelectedWithThreshold f B` for exactness and the stage contract; the emission equation for the
stage contract.

## What is not claimed

- No raw program. `levelOrder` is typed and `noncomputable`.
- No statement about order or multiplicity relative to `canonical`; the two lists are different
  lists with the same members. `stageChildren levelOrder B` and `stageChildren canonical B` are
  therefore different ordered lists, and only the former is intended for `Emits`.
- No new semantic content: exactness is transferred from #1394/#1395.

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteGlobalTailTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSyntaxChargeBudget
open MixedSameRankResidue ActualZeroClassReplacement ActualRankedRowColumns
open ActualReadChargeIteration ActualFiniteGlobalTail InnerTerminationTargets

/-- Sufficient budget, not the original exact grouped signed charge. -/
def syntaxBudget (r : Nat) (terms : List WeightedOperand) : Nat :=
  terms.length * 3 ^ r

/-- Total length bound on raw syntax bytes; this program does not
decode or validate any raw operand. -/
def syntaxBudgetCode (r : Nat) (terms : List WeightedCode) : Nat :=
  terms.length * 3 ^ r

/-- Count and ordinary value support have disjoint operand key spaces;
signed cancellation may remove keys but cannot add an occurrence. -/
def ExactDistinctSupportBudget : Prop :=
  ∀ (r : Nat) (c : Int) (raw : List Read),
    let row := rankedRow r c raw
    row.count.support.card + row.value.support.card ≤ raw.length

def ExactChargeBudget : Prop :=
  (∀ (r : Nat) (s : ReadState), stateCharge r s ≤ syntaxBudget r (syntaxOf s)) ∧
  (∀ (r : Nat) (terms : List WeightedOperand), syntaxCharge r terms ≤ syntaxBudget r terms) ∧
  ∀ s : ReadState, stateCharge 0 s = 0

def BudgetCodeExact : Prop :=
  Primrec₂ syntaxBudgetCode ∧
  ∀ (r : Nat) (terms : List WeightedOperand),
    syntaxBudgetCode r (terms.map encodeWeighted) = syntaxBudget r terms

def FullActualSyntaxChargeBudget : Prop :=
  ExactDistinctSupportBudget ∧ ExactChargeBudget ∧ BudgetCodeExact

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSyntaxChargeBudget

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSignedRouteCartesianTargets
public import Mathlib.Computability.Primrec.List

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.RawPacketAlgebra
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open PreparedProjection (LowerOperand LowerOperandCode PreparedPacketCode preparedPacketCode)
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet append shift)
open ActualSignedRouteCartesian (choices tuplePacket)

/-- The existing packet code (#728): table bytes and formula code. -/
def encodePacket (p : Packet) : PreparedPacketCode := preparedPacketCode p.1 p.2

/-- Operand-code list carried by table bytes (empty on undecodable bytes). -/
def tableOf (bytes : Nat) : List LowerOperandCode :=
  (Encodable.decode bytes : Option (List LowerOperandCode)).getD []

def shiftNameCode (d n : Nat) : Nat := if n = 0 then 0 else d + n

def shiftItemCode (d : Nat) (s : NormalForm.Code.ItemData) : NormalForm.Code.ItemData :=
  (s.1,shiftNameCode d s.2.1,s.2.2)

def shiftRowCode (d : Nat) (r : NormalForm.Code.RowData) : NormalForm.Code.RowData :=
  (r.1,r.2.map (fun a => (a.1,shiftItemCode d a.2)))

def shiftAtomData (d : Nat) (a : NormalForm.Code.AtomData) : NormalForm.Code.AtomData :=
  (a.1,a.2.1,shiftRowCode d a.2.2)

def shiftAtomCode (d payload : Nat) : Nat :=
  Encodable.encode (shiftAtomData d (LinearRows.Code.decodeAtom payload))

/-- Positive-name shift on the radix-six formula code, by the existing atom map. -/
def shiftCode (d code : Nat) : Nat := LinearRows.Code.mapAtoms (shiftAtomCode d) code

def appendCode (l r : PreparedPacketCode) : PreparedPacketCode :=
  (Encodable.encode (tableOf l.1 ++ tableOf r.1),
    LinearRows.Code.conjunction l.2 (shiftCode (tableOf l.1).length r.2))

def unitCode : PreparedPacketCode := encodePacket ([],.truth)

def tupleCode (cs : List PreparedPacketCode) : PreparedPacketCode := cs.foldr appendCode unitCode

def choicesCode : List (List PreparedPacketCode) → List (List PreparedPacketCode)
  | [] => [[]]
  | row::rows => row.flatMap (fun c => (choicesCode rows).map (List.cons c))

/-- Raw join: one joined packet code per Cartesian choice, in literal order. -/
def joinCode (rows : List (List PreparedPacketCode)) : List PreparedPacketCode :=
  (choicesCode rows).map tupleCode

def ExactShiftCode : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : Nat) (p : NormalForm.Formula), shiftCode d p.encode = (shift d p).encode

def ExactAppendCode : Prop :=
  ∀ l r : Packet, appendCode (encodePacket l) (encodePacket r) = encodePacket (append l r)

def ExactTupleCode : Prop :=
  ∀ ps : List Packet, tupleCode (ps.map encodePacket) = encodePacket (tuplePacket ps)

def ExactChoicesCode : Prop :=
  ∀ rows : List (List Packet),
    choicesCode (rows.map (List.map encodePacket)) = (choices rows).map (List.map encodePacket)

def ExactJoinCode : Prop :=
  ∀ rows : List (List Packet),
    joinCode (rows.map (List.map encodePacket)) = ((choices rows).map tuplePacket).map encodePacket

def JoinCalibration : Prop :=
  ExactShiftCode ∧ ExactAppendCode ∧ ExactTupleCode ∧ ExactChoicesCode ∧ ExactJoinCode

def JoinEffectivity : Prop :=
  Primrec₂ shiftCode ∧ Primrec₂ appendCode ∧ Primrec tupleCode ∧ Primrec choicesCode ∧
    Primrec joinCode

def FullRawPacketAlgebraJoin : Prop := JoinCalibration ∧ JoinEffectivity

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.RawPacketAlgebra

theorem filterMapTransport {α β γ δ : Type} (f : α → β) (g : α → Option γ)
    (g' : β → Option δ) (h : γ → δ) (l : List α)
    (pointwise : ∀ a, g' (f a) = (g a).map h) :
    (l.map f).filterMap g' = (l.filterMap g).map h := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    cases hga : g a with
    | none =>
      have h1 : g' (f a) = none := by simp [pointwise,hga]
      rw [List.map_cons,List.filterMap_cons_none h1,List.filterMap_cons_none hga]
      exact ih
    | some c =>
      have h1 : g' (f a) = some (h c) := by simp [pointwise,hga]
      rw [List.map_cons,List.filterMap_cons_some h1,List.filterMap_cons_some hga,List.map_cons,ih]

    (h : γ → δ) (l : List α) (pointwise : ∀ a, g' (f a) = (g a).map h) :
    (l.map f).flatMap g' = (l.flatMap g).map h := by
  induction l with

    (l : List α) (pointwise : ∀ a, g' a = (g a).map h) :
    l.flatMap g' = (l.flatMap g).map h := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [List.flatMap_cons,List.flatMap_cons,pointwise,ih,List.map_append]

  cases op with
  | coordinate r => simp [nonlinear,NonlinearOperand]
  | count r l m => simp [nonlinear,NonlinearOperand]
  | ordinary r F =>
      cases F <;> simp [nonlinear,NonlinearOperand,SelectedNonlinearImageBounds.NonlinearField]

  intro top ts
  have cal : tapeHighestCode top (groupRaw (ts.map encodeWeighted)) =
      (groupTyped ts).any (activeTest top) := (exactRawCanonicalNodeCalibration top ts []).2.1
  rw [cal]
  simp only [CanonicalActive,List.any_eq_true,activeTest,Bool.and_eq_true,decide_eq_true_eq,
    nonlinearExact,and_assoc]

theorem tapesExact (ts : List WeightedOperand) :
    candidateTapes (groupRaw (ts.map encodeWeighted)) =

  (exactCanonicalAnswerPairs.2 ts).2

theorem guardExact (R : Rendering) (hR : R.Exact) (top : Nat) (ts : List WeightedOperand)

      encodePacket (guard top (groupTyped ts) a) := by
  have cal : labelsCode (groupRaw (ts.map encodeWeighted)) =
      (labels (groupTyped ts)).map encodeLabel := (exactRawCanonicalNodeCalibration top ts a).1
  rw [cal]
  exact hR.guard top (groupTyped ts) a

coefficient and the encoded typed successor. -/
theorem nodeOutExact (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer) :

      (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a,
        (canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms a).map encodeSyntax) := by
  have node := exactRawCanonicalNode true s.constant s.terms a
  have branch := (exactRawNodeBranches s.constant (s.terms.map encodeTerm)
    (a.map Answer.code)).2.1

theorem stepExact (R : Rendering) (hR : R.Exact) (top : Nat) (pre : List Packet)
    (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer) :
    stepOfCode R top (encodeEntry (pre,s)) (a.map Answer.code) =
      (stepOf top (pre,s) a).map encodeEntry := by
  have out := nodeOutExact s a
  have g := guardExact R hR top s.terms a
  by_cases zero : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0
  · rw [stepOf_zero top pre s a zero]
    show (if (nodeOut (encodeSyntax s) (a.map Answer.code)).1 = 0 then
        (nodeOut (encodeSyntax s) (a.map Answer.code)).2.map
          (fun raw => (pre.map encodePacket ++
            [R.guard top (labelsCode (groupRaw (s.terms.map encodeWeighted)))
              (a.map Answer.code)],raw))
      else none) = _
    rw [out,g]
    show (if maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0 then
        ((canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms a).map encodeSyntax).map
          (fun raw => (pre.map encodePacket ++
            [encodePacket (guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a)],raw))
      else none) = _
    rw [if_pos zero]
    cases canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms a with
    | none => rfl
    | some o => simp [encodeEntry]
  · rw [stepOf_nonzero top pre s a zero]
    show (if (nodeOut (encodeSyntax s) (a.map Answer.code)).1 = 0 then _ else none) = none
    rw [out]
    exact if_neg zero

  by_cases active : CanonicalActive top s.terms
  · rw [children_active top pre s active]
    show (if tapeHighestCode top (groupRaw (s.terms.map encodeWeighted)) = true then
        (candidateTapes (groupRaw (s.terms.map encodeWeighted))).filterMap
          (stepOfCode R top (encodeEntry (pre,s)))

      (stepOfCode R top (encodeEntry (pre,s))) encodeEntry _
      (fun a => stepExact R hR top pre s a)

    show (if tapeHighestCode top (groupRaw (s.terms.map encodeWeighted)) = true then _
      else []) = []

  show (if (if positive then signedBit test c else !(signedBit test c)) = true then
      encodePacket ([],.truth) else encodePacket ([],.falsity)) =
    encodePacket ([],if (if positive then signedBit test c else !(signedBit test c)) = true
      then .truth else .falsity)
  generalize (if positive then signedBit test c else !(signedBit test c)) = b
  cases b <;> rfl

theorem leafExact (R : Rendering) (hR : R.Exact) (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool)
    (pre : List Packet) (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer) :
    leafOfCode R top (orderCode test) positive (encodeEntry (pre,s)) (a.map Answer.code) =
      (leafOf top (pre,s) a).map (fun route => encodePacket (packet test positive route)) := by
  have out := nodeOutExact s a
  have g := guardExact R hR top s.terms a
  by_cases zero : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0
  · rw [leafOf_zero top pre s a zero]

    show (if (nodeOut (encodeSyntax s) (a.map Answer.code)).1 = 0 then none
      else some ((pre.map encodePacket ++

            (a.map Answer.code)]).foldr R.append
        (signedTipCode (orderCode test) positive
          (nodeOut (encodeSyntax s) (a.map Answer.code)).1))) =
      some (encodePacket ((pre ++ [guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a]).foldr append
        (terminalPacket test positive (.signed (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a)))))
    rw [out,g]
    show (if maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0 then none
      else some ((pre.map encodePacket ++
          [encodePacket (guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a)]).foldr R.append
        (signedTipCode (orderCode test) positive (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a)))) = _
    rw [if_neg zero,signedTipExact]

    rw [joined,joinExact R hR]

    (positive : Bool) (e : Entry) :

      (leaves top test positive e).map (fun route => encodePacket (packet test positive route)) := by
  rcases e with ⟨pre,s⟩
  by_cases active : CanonicalActive top s.terms
  · rw [leaves_active top test positive pre s active]
    show (if tapeHighestCode top (groupRaw (s.terms.map encodeWeighted)) = true then
        (candidateTapes (groupRaw (s.terms.map encodeWeighted))).filterMap

      else _) = _
    rw [if_pos ((exactRawActivity top s.terms).mpr active),tapesExact s.terms]
    exact filterMapTransport (List.map Answer.code) (leafOf top (pre,s))
      (leafOfCode R top (orderCode test) positive (encodeEntry (pre,s)))
      (fun route => encodePacket (packet test positive route)) _
      (fun a => leafExact R hR top test positive pre s a)
  · rw [leaves_idle top test positive pre s active]
    show (if tapeHighestCode top (groupRaw (s.terms.map encodeWeighted)) = true then _
      else [(pre.map encodePacket).foldr R.append
        (R.linear top (encodeSyntax s) (orderCode test) positive)]) =
      [encodePacket (pre.foldr append
        (canonicalPacket top s.constant s.terms test.test positive))]
    rw [if_neg (fun h => active ((exactRawActivity top s.terms).mp h)),hR.linear,
      joinExact R hR]

theorem exactRawLevelEntries : ExactRawLevelEntries := by
  intro R hR top s n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    show (levelCode R top (encodeSyntax s) n).flatMap (childrenCode R top) =
      ((level top s n).flatMap (children top)).map encodeEntry
    rw [ih]
    exact flatMapTransport encodeEntry (children top) (childrenCode R top) encodeEntry _
      (fun e => childrenExact R hR top e)

  intro R hR top test positive fuel s
  rw [List.map_map]
  exact flatMapPointwise (fun n => (level top s n).flatMap (leaves top test positive))
    (fun n => (levelCode R top (encodeSyntax s) n).flatMap
      (leavesCode R top (orderCode test) positive))
    (fun route => encodePacket (packet test positive route)) (List.range (fuel+1))
    (fun n => by
      rw [exactRawLevelEntries R hR top s n]
      exact flatMapTransport encodeEntry (leaves top test positive)
        (leavesCode R top (orderCode test) positive)
        (fun route => encodePacket (packet test positive route)) _
        (fun e => leavesExact R hR top test positive e))

theorem signedRowExact (R : Rendering) (hR : R.Exact) (r top : Nat) (c : Int)
    (ts : List WeightedOperand) (bit : Bool) (test : OrderTest) :
    signedCode R top (orderCode test) bit
        (syntaxBudgetCode r (cleanupCode (encodeSyntax ⟨c,ts⟩)).2)
        (cleanupCode (encodeSyntax ⟨c,ts⟩)) =
      (StageCallbackLevelOrder.alternatives r top (.signed ⟨cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩,test,bit⟩)).map
        encodePacket := by
  rw [cleanupCalibration]
  show signedCode R top (orderCode test) bit
      (syntaxBudgetCode r ((cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩).terms.map encodeWeighted))
      (encodeSyntax (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩)) = _
  rw [budgetCodeExact.2]
  exact exactRawSignedPackets R hR top test bit (syntaxBudget r (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩).terms)
